text:
For a soy sauce substitute that maintains the savory, umami profile of a stir-fry while being soy-free, coconut aminos are an excellent choice. They offer a similar salty-savory flavor but are naturally sweeter and lower in sodium. Another option is tamari if the allergy is strictly to soy proteins but not gluten, though coconut aminos are safer for strict soy allergies. You can also use a mixture of beef or mushroom broth with a splash of vinegar and a pinch of salt to mimic the depth of flavor.
